title: HB479 (2020 Regular): Firearms; prohibit discharge near petroleum.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2020/html/HB/0400-0499/HB0479IN.htm)
provenance.note: As-filed text; no passage vote recorded. Existing sentence on discharging toward a dwelling kept, with '(1)' and 'or her' added.

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 97-37-30): (2) A person who willfully discharges his or her firearm near any business or property that contains flammable or explosive petroleum products is guilty of a felony punishable by a fine of not more than Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) or imprisonment not exceeding five (5) years in the custody of the Department of Corrections, or both.
